blocks.prompt: 5 Find the velocity, acceleration, speed, and direction of motion of the particle with position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t) = e^{t}\sin t\,\hat{i} + (t^{3} - 2t)\hat{j} + \arctan(2t)\,\hat{k}\) at \(t = 0\). Interpret the results by describing the particle's motion at that instant, including how fast and in what direction it is moving, whether it is speeding up or slowing down, and how its path is curving.
blocks.explanation:
Kaam wohi hai jo Questions 1-4 mein tha, lekin components thore mushkil hain.
Diya kya hai? \(\mathbf{r}(t) = e^{t}\sin t\,\hat{i} + (t^{3} - 2t)\hat{j} + \arctan(2t)\,\hat{k}\) aur \(t = 0\).
Find kya karna hai? Velocity, acceleration, speed, direction aur harkat ka bayan.
Rules: \(e^{t}\sin t\) ke liye product rule, aur \(\arctan(2t)\) ke liye chain rule ke saath \(\arctan\) ka derivative.
Plan: pehle har component ka derivative alag se saaf saaf nikalo, phir \(t = 0\) rakho, aur aakhir mein \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}\) aur angle se tashreeh.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = e^{t}\sin t\,\hat{i} + (t^{3} - 2t)\hat{j} + \arctan(2t)\,\hat{k}\), \(t = 0\).
Maloom karna: velocity, acceleration, speed, direction of motion aur tashreeh.
Tareeqa: har component ko ek dafa differentiate kar ke \(\mathbf{v}(t)\), dobara kar ke \(\mathbf{a}(t)\), phir \(t = 0\) rakhna. Speed \(= |\mathbf{v}|\) aur direction \(= \frac{\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{v}|}\). Tashreeh (interpretation) ke liye: \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}\) ka sign batata hai ke particle tez ho raha hai ya dheema, aur \(\mathbf{a}\) ka jo hissa \(\mathbf{v}\) ke aar paar hai woh batata hai ke path kis taraf mur raha hai.

Components ke derivatives
\[\dfrac{d}{dt}(e^{t}\sin t) = e^{t}\sin t + e^{t}\cos t\]
\[\dfrac{d}{dt}(t^{3} - 2t) = 3t^{2} - 2\]
\[\dfrac{d}{dt}\arctan(2t) = \dfrac{2}{1 + 4t^{2}}\]
Kyun: pehla component do functions ka product hai, is liye product rule \((uv)' = u'v + uv'\). Teesre mein \(\frac{d}{dt}\arctan u = \frac{1}{1 + u^{2}}\frac{du}{dt}\), jahan \(u = 2t\) aur \(\frac{du}{dt} = 2\).
Dhyan dein: upar wala 2 (chain rule se) bhool jana aam ghalti hai; \(\frac{1}{1 + 4t^{2}}\) adhoora jawab hai.

Acceleration
\[\dfrac{d}{dt}\left[e^{t}(\sin t + \cos t)\right] = 2e^{t}\cos t\]
\[\dfrac{d}{dt}(3t^{2} - 2) = 6t\]
\[\dfrac{d}{dt}\left[2(1 + 4t^{2})^{-1}\right]\]
\[= -\dfrac{16t}{(1 + 4t^{2})^{2}}\]
\[\mathbf{a}(t) = 2e^{t}\cos t\,\hat{i} + 6t\,\hat{j}\]
\[\quad - \dfrac{16t}{(1 + 4t^{2})^{2}}\,\hat{k}\]
\[\mathbf{a}(0) = 2\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j} - 0\,\hat{k} = 2\,\hat{i}\]
Kyun: product rule se \(e^{t}(\sin t + \cos t) + e^{t}(\cos t - \sin t)\); \(\sin t\) wale terms cancel ho kar \(2e^{t}\cos t\) bacha. Teesre component ko \(2(1 + 4t^{2})^{-1}\) likh kar chain rule lagaya: \(2(-1)(1 + 4t^{2})^{-2}(8t)\). \(t = 0\) par yeh zero hai.

Speed
\[|\mathbf{v}(0)| = \sqrt{1^{2} + (-2)^{2} + 2^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{9} = 3\]
Kyun: velocity ki lambai; yahan saaf number 3 aa gaya.

Direction of motion
\[\hat{\mathbf{v}}(0) = \dfrac{\hat{i} - 2\,\hat{j} + 2\,\hat{k}}{3}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{3}\hat{i} - \dfrac{2}{3}\hat{j} + \dfrac{2}{3}\hat{k}\]
Kyun: velocity ko speed 3 se divide kiya.

Tashreeh (interpretation)
Position: \(\mathbf{r}(0) = 0\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j} + \arctan 0\,\hat{k} = \mathbf{0}\), yani particle origin par hai. Woh 3 units per second se chal raha hai: positive \(x\), negative \(y\) aur positive \(z\) ki taraf (zyada tar \(-y\) aur \(+z\) ki taraf).
\[\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = (1)(2) + (-2)(0)\]
\[\quad + (2)(0) = 2 > 0\]
To particle tez ho raha hai, aur speed barhne ki sharah \(\frac{\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}}{|\mathbf{v}|} = \frac{2}{3}\) unit/s har second hai. \(|\mathbf{a}(0)| = 2\) hai, to
\[\cos\theta = \dfrac{2}{3 \times 2} = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[\theta \approx 70.53^{\circ}\]
Yani acceleration ka zyada hissa velocity ke aar paar hai: path kaafi mur raha hai (positive \(x\) ki taraf, jidhar \(\mathbf{a} = 2\,\hat{i}\) hai), jab ke speed sirf aahista barh rahi hai. Question 4 se muqabla kijiye: wahan angle \(10^{\circ}\) tha aur path bas halka sa mura tha.
Kyun: \(\mathbf{a}\) aur \(\mathbf{v}\) ka angle jitna bara (\(90^{\circ}\) se kam), \(\mathbf{a}\) ka utna zyada hissa morne mein aur utna kam tez karne mein lagta hai.

Khulasa
Ek nazar mein: particle origin par hai, 3 units per second se \(\frac{1}{3}\hat{i} - \frac{2}{3}\hat{j} + \frac{2}{3}\hat{k}\) ki simt mein ja raha hai, aahista tez ho raha hai, aur positive \(x\) ki taraf kaafi mur raha hai. Is sawal ki asal mushkil differentiation thi: product rule, chain rule aur \(\arctan\) ka derivative. Agar yeh teen qaide pakke hon to baaki kaam bilkul pehle sawalon jaisa hai. Is liye mashq ke liye in teenon ko alag alag functions par dohrate rahiye.
blocks.final_answer: \(\mathbf{v}(0) = \hat{i} - 2\,\hat{j} + 2\,\hat{k}\), \(\mathbf{a}(0) = 2\,\hat{i}\), speed \(= 3\), direction \(\hat{\mathbf{v}} = \frac{1}{3}\hat{i} - \frac{2}{3}\hat{j} + \frac{2}{3}\hat{k}\). Origin par particle aahista tez ho raha hai (\(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = 2 > 0\)), aur \(\mathbf{v}\), \(\mathbf{a}\) ke darmiyan taqreeban \(70.5^{\circ}\) angle hai, is liye path positive \(x\) ki taraf kaafi mur raha hai.

blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 11.3 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain (Unit 11 ki kisi exercise ke jawab kitab mein nahin hain). Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) jaise angles radians mein hain, is liye calculator RAD mode mein rakhein. Apna hal yahan wale hal se mila kar dekhiye.
